name: next-shops
description: E-Commerce Platform for Uganda - Next Level Shopping

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "FRONTEND,ADMIN,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm run dev to start all apps'

author: Next Shops Uganda
